asA: shelf consumer applying the edge-cloudflare-turnstile v1.0.0 blueprint on a Workers project using the probe-pack-edge-cloudflare-turnstile fixture
iWant: the Turnstile widget to mount on my public form with the elicited TURNSTILE_SITEKEY, to inject only Cloudflare Turnstile JS (no other third-party script), and to populate the hidden Cf-Turnstile-Response token field on submit
soThat: every submit that reaches my server carries a Turnstile response my server-side verifier can check
title: T-5 widget mount: elicited sitekey renders Turnstile widget with token populated on submit

acceptanceCriteria.description: When the fixture page loads with the always-pass test sitekey, the Turnstile widget mounts and an iframe is present whose src origin is https://challenges.cloudflare.com; the page loads no third-party script from any other origin; on submit the form payload carries a non-empty Cf-Turnstile-Response value.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture form loaded with default sitekey pass and the pinned always-pass test sitekey
acceptanceCriteria.when: the widget renders and the operator submits
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Turnstile widget is mounted, its iframe origin is Cloudflare Turnstile only, and the submit payload contains the Cf-Turnstile-Response token
